workflows.name: Campaign Start
workflows.purpose: Validates campaign configuration, market compliance, and target ICP.

workflows.name: Prospect Source Import
workflows.purpose: Imports permitted B2B prospects from authorized directories.

workflows.name: Prospect Research
workflows.purpose: Executes public website crawl and gathers evidence quotes.

workflows.name: Contact Verification
workflows.purpose: Validates business email, phone, and website domain existence.

workflows.name: Deduplication
workflows.purpose: Normalizes domains, emails, and phones to prevent duplicate contact.

workflows.name: Lead Qualification
workflows.purpose: Computes deterministic 100-point score across 6 categories.

workflows.name: Compliance Eligibility
workflows.purpose: Verifies CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR, TCPA, and suppression list.

workflows.name: Message Personalization
workflows.purpose: Calls Claude to generate consultative, factual outreach copy.

workflows.name: Message Quality Control
workflows.purpose: Lints for spam phrases, verifies cited quotes, and checks opt-out notice.

workflows.name: Outbound Dispatch
workflows.purpose: Dispatches approved messages via Smartlead/GHL/WhatsApp.

workflows.name: Outbound Event Processing
workflows.purpose: Processes delivery, open, bounce, and complaint events.

workflows.name: Reply Classification
workflows.purpose: Classifies responses via Claude Haiku and updates CRM.

workflows.name: Interested Lead Routing
workflows.purpose: Routes interested prospects to AI sales consultant or demo.

workflows.name: Follow-Up Scheduling
workflows.purpose: Schedules compliant, adaptive follow-ups up to 3 touches max.

workflows.name: Follow-Up Cancellation
workflows.purpose: Cancels follow-ups on reply, demo click, purchase, or opt-out.

workflows.name: Demo Invitation
workflows.purpose: Issues signed, expiring demo link with encoded scenario.

workflows.name: Demo Provisioning
workflows.purpose: Allocates isolated ephemeral sandbox with synthetic data.

workflows.name: Demo Personalization
workflows.purpose: Loads industry-appropriate scenarios (Vet Day or HVAC emergency).

workflows.name: Demo Session Start
workflows.purpose: Records session open, updates GHL CRM stage to 'Demo Started'.

workflows.name: Demo Interaction Events
workflows.purpose: Tracks explored modules (GPS map, time-clock, prescriptions).

workflows.name: Demo Completion
workflows.purpose: Records successful tour completion and advances CRM stage.

workflows.name: Demo Follow-Up
workflows.purpose: Dispatches contextual summary of explored features and trial offer.

workflows.name: Demo Expiration & Cleanup
workflows.purpose: Revokes expired demo tokens and recycles sandbox memory.

workflows.name: Trial Registration
workflows.purpose: Validates trial eligibility and records prospect business details.

workflows.name: Trial License Provisioning
workflows.purpose: Issues 14/30-day trial license token in Supabase.

workflows.name: Trial Activation Guidance
workflows.purpose: Delivers mobile PWA install guide and 3 quick-start milestones.

workflows.name: Trial Milestone Evaluation
workflows.purpose: Monitors customer feature usage and offers proactive help.

workflows.name: Trial Expiration Management
workflows.purpose: Sends transparent renewal terms and upgrade links before expiry.

workflows.name: Checkout Started
workflows.purpose: Creates secure Stripe/Wompi checkout session and records deal intent.

workflows.name: Payment Verification
workflows.purpose: Authenticates authoritative payment signatures and cleared funds.

workflows.name: Paid License Provisioning
workflows.purpose: Provisions active multi-tenant license with purchased seats.

workflows.name: GHL Closed-Won Sync
workflows.purpose: Advances GHL Opportunity to 'Closed Won' and creates sub-account.

workflows.name: Failed Provisioning Recovery
workflows.purpose: Safely retries provisioning and alerts engineering on fault.

workflows.name: Subscription Renewal
workflows.purpose: Extends license expiration date upon recurring subscription renewal.

workflows.name: Payment Failure Handling
workflows.purpose: Initiates 3-step polite dunning sequence and enters grace period.

workflows.name: Customer Welcome
workflows.purpose: Presents post-purchase welcome portal and onboarding booking.

workflows.name: Onboarding Questionnaire
workflows.purpose: Collects software, scheduling, and staff migration requirements.

workflows.name: Onboarding Booking
workflows.purpose: Syncs 50-minute personal implementation session on team calendar.

workflows.name: Onboarding Reminder
workflows.purpose: Sends meeting link and preparation checklist to customer.

workflows.name: AI Onboarding Brief
workflows.purpose: Generates executive customer intelligence briefing for the engineer.

workflows.name: Onboarding Completion
workflows.purpose: Records verified configuration, sample tests, and live status.

workflows.name: Customer Success Handoff
workflows.purpose: Enrolls account into adoption tracking and retention milestones.

workflows.name: Global Suppression Sync
workflows.purpose: Synchronizes suppressed contacts across GHL, n8n, and Supabase.

workflows.name: Integration Health Monitor
workflows.purpose: Heartbeat probe of Supabase, GHL, WhatsApp, and n8n webhooks.

workflows.name: Workflow Failure Monitor
workflows.purpose: Captures failed steps, logs stack traces, and triggers retry.

workflows.name: Data Reconciliation
workflows.purpose: Reconciles Supabase licenses with GHL contacts and Stripe events.

workflows.name: Analytics Aggregation
workflows.purpose: Calculates daily conversion funnels, CAC, and channel attribution.

workflows.name: Daily Executive Summary
workflows.purpose: Sends executive report: cash collected, active clients, and alerts.

workflows.name: Agent Cost Monitor
workflows.purpose: Tracks Anthropic token spend and alerts if cost ceiling approached.

workflows.name: Campaign Safety Kill Switch
workflows.purpose: Instantly halts all outbound messaging on anomaly or admin trigger.
